scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('./client')){cp.execSync('cd client && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'})} else {cp.execSync('next build', {stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('./client')){cp.execSync('cd client && npm start', {stdio:'inherit'})} else {cp.execSync('next start', {stdio:'inherit'})}"
